details:
Pressing the Enter button on the system keyboard types a newline. This is the only button to submit text from this system keyboard, and closing the keyboard also cancels text entry entirely. As a result, it is impossible to submit text to anything other than the chatbox and search. Specifically, the save code entry in Idle Home and the Last Will in Salem.

My somewhat related suggestion to keep the text box open might help:

https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/standalone-vr-add-a-way-to-return-to-the-built-in-keyboard-after-the-system-keyb

As well, if you decide to make the text box not close when the B button is pressed, maybe add a hint like "Press B to return focus here" or something.

I won't get my hopes up for getting Pico itself to support the base model Pico 4 nowadays (especially from a small individual like me, I've already sent a few bug reports with no response, but your company seems to be talking to them) so I'm coming here. (if anything, them adding a dedicated "Submit" button instead of changing the function of "Enter" on their keyboard would be the best way forward in my opinion)
title: The Pico system keyboard cannot type into world text boxes.
